description:
HushPinterest v0.0.14: 36 patches for Pinterest 14.44.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. This one moves to Pinterest 14.44.0 on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, and it's the first signed release (signer 46a2 ea94 21d7 b269). Download pin no longer sticks at Queued and now saves videos Pinterest only streams. New this time: Change package name, Hide Inbox updates, Hide Home suggestions, Hide Assistant and Hide comment previews. Validation: 1198 runtime tests passed. All 281 patch tests passed. All 36 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.44.0. Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.

### What's new

* The patches now target Pinterest 14.44.0, version code 14448030. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
* The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer to apply them.
* The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows the signer when you add or update the source, and it should read `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. After that, Manager won't take a HushPinterest update signed by another key. The public key is [`morphe-signing.pub`](morphe-signing.pub) in this repo.
* Hide ads now covers Meta's ad network as well. Pinterest 14.43.0 started filling some ad slots through Meta Audience Network, and with Hide ads on, Pinterest's own consent check answers no for Meta, so that SDK never starts. Export report lists it as `Meta ad SDK` under Hide ads coverage.
* Long-press download now covers the newer list-style long-press menu too. Download shows up there and saves the pin you pressed, and the switches that hide Save, Send and Search image work on that menu as well.
* With GmsCore support, Continue with Google no longer does nothing when microG-RE can't be reached. You get a message saying to install it, turn it on or open it, and the setup guide says to add your Google account there first. Export report has a new Google sign-in section (no account names, no tokens) so a failure can be traced.
* GmsCore support no longer switches off Android's own sign-in helper on a phone without microG-RE, so a password manager can offer your saved Pinterest login on the login screen again. Continue with Google still goes to microG-RE, so without it you get the message saying to install it. While microG-RE is installed the helper steps aside completely and every sign-in goes to microG-RE.
* Copy image no longer puts the picture over something you copied while it was still loading. If the clipboard changed after you tapped it, or HushPinterest can't tell (you'd left Pinterest by then, or your phone doesn't let Pinterest read the clipboard), the picture is dropped and a message says it wasn't copied.
* Download pin no longer leaves a pin stuck at "Queued" for hours. On some phones Android holds Pinterest's downloads back to save battery, so the file never showed up. Now, if a download hasn't started within a few seconds, HushPinterest saves it itself, to the same folder under the same name, as long as your network matches the Wi-Fi and roaming switches. You get the usual "Saved in" message, and Download history shows it as saved. (#27, #29)
* Download pin now saves videos Pinterest only streams. Those used to stop at "Pinterest only streams this video". HushPinterest fetches the picture and the sound itself and joins them into one MP4 in your download folder, copying them as they are so nothing gets re-encoded. It follows the same Wi-Fi and roaming switches, and Download history can open the file. (#27)
* Two new switches under Pin actions, both off to start. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download from its menu, and Download pins you save downloads whatever you save, from any screen.
* New `Hide Assistant` switch under Interface takes Pinterest's AI Assistant out of search, boards and pins on accounts that get it. Regular search keeps working. It starts off.
* New `Hide pins you've already saved` switch under Feed takes pins you've saved or own out of your home feed. Your boards and search still show them. It starts off.
* New `Hide Home suggestions` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. It takes Pinterest's "More ideas for your board" and "Inspired by your interests" rows off Home, and the "See more like this?" bubble off pins. It starts off. (#30)
* New `Change package name` patch, not selected by default. Pick it in Expert mode and the patched app installs beside the Pinterest you already have instead of replacing it, as a separate app called HushPinterest with its own sign-in. You can choose the package name and the app name when you patch, and HushPinterest settings > About shows which package it runs as. (#28)
* New `Hide Inbox updates` patch with its own switch under Notifications. It leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox so Pinterest doesn't load it. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and the activity updates in that section go with them. Messages stay. It starts off. (#30)
* `No screenshot share menu` now also works when you screenshot a pin you've opened. Pinterest 14.44.0 listens for screenshots on that screen by itself, and it has a second way of spotting new screenshots in your photos, so the "Save or share Pin" sheet still came up there. Home, opened pins, boards and Pinterest's quiz screens all stay quiet now while the switch is on.
* `Hide lens button on pins` now also hides the lens on pins with several pictures, which have a second lens of their own in the picture carousel. (#20)
* `Hide Search image label on pins` now also turns off the glow Pinterest puts around the lens. (#19)
* Hide closeup buttons has four new switches for the row under a pin's picture: like, comment, share and more, each on its own. Hiding more also hides the way into that pin's menu from there, Download pin included, and the row says so. They all start off and sit on the Interface page. (#22)
* `Hide topic suggestions` works on Pinterest 14.43.0 again. It had latched onto a search suggestion cell instead of the "Ideas you might love" row, so the row kept showing under pins with the switch on. Now the row goes away with no gap, and it comes back when you turn the switch off or pause HushPinterest.
* `Hide Create button` and `Hide Notifications button` now work on Pinterest 14.43.0 accounts that keep those buttons at the top of Home instead of in the bottom bar. The switches did nothing visible there before. The bell or Inbox button goes along with Notifications, and both come back when you turn their switch off or pause HushPinterest.
* New `Hide Remix button on pins` switch takes the Remix button off pins that show it. The Cutout button next to it stays. It starts off. (#25)
* New `Hide Visit site button on pins` switch takes away the Visit site button under pins that link to a website. It starts off. (#26)
* New `Smaller Save button on pins` switch draws the red Save button on a pin you open at four fifths of its size, still at the end of its row. It starts off. (#24)
* New `Hide comment previews` switch under Interface, right under Hide suggested replies. It hides only the comments and comment photos shown under a pin, so the comment box and the way into all the comments stay. Hide comments still hides the whole section, previews included, and while it's on the new switch says so and keeps its own setting for later. It starts off.
* New `Save button color` row paints that Save button in any hex color you type, like #3366FF or #36F. Light colors get dark text so the button stays readable, and Clear brings back Pinterest's red. The color goes into exported settings files along with your switches. (#23)
* `Black pin menu` now paints the See more and See less cards in a pin's menu black too. They used to stay gray on the black sheet. (#21)
* `Black comments` turns the quick replies above the reply box (the emoji and "Love it!" buttons) black as well. They stayed gray on Pinterest 14.43.0. (#21)
* `Black comments` no longer flashes a gray bar across the top of a video pin's comments while they load. (#12)
* The settings code drops a `Set when you patched` section that never had a page to show, along with its five translations. Nothing changes on screen.
* The README now says what Pause leaves in place (GmsCore support's sign-in and push setup, the removed ad tracking permissions, a changed package name and Firebase's manifest flags), how much Copy image and Share image fetch and keep, and how Android's developer verification will affect installing a patched Pinterest. The patch reference and the factory map now describe the 36 patches on main and Pinterest 14.44.0, where they still described the older 14.39.0 catalog.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet, a pin's menu, the Save to sheet that lists your boards, the other menus and sheets, the buttons over boards and profiles, and Pinterest's pop-up messages can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Gives the patched Pinterest its own package name and app name (HushPinterest unless you pick another), so it installs beside the Pinterest you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The copy's package name. Each copy needs its own.
The name under the copy's icon, up to 30 characters.

patches.name: Custom save sound
patches.description: Plays a sound file you pick on your phone when you save a pin, in place of Pinterest's chime. Pinterest's other sounds stay. Starts off. Pick the sound with Pick a save sound in HushPinterest settings > Interface, which turns the switch on for you.

patches.name: Custom splash logo
patches.description: Shows a logo you pick on the screen you see while Pinterest starts, in place of Pinterest's, on Android 13 and newer. Pick the picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch. Leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

options.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, up to 2048 pixels a side. All of it shows, centered inside a circle, so a square picture with a clear background looks best. Leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo.

patches.name: Customize board tabs
patches.description: Tidies the top of board tabs on Home. You can hide the See board button and the More ideas for line and move the board name. You can also stop the picture changing by keeping it or by choosing a pin, a photo from your phone or plain black. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Expand board list
patches.description: Opens the Save to sheet all the way up when you save a pin, so more of your boards show without dragging it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Filter feed
patches.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, pins you've already saved out of your home feed, search and More to explore, and Pinterest's suggestion rows out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Another switch takes out the rows you pick from a list, including the ones HushPinterest adds. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Fold related pins
patches.description: Puts an arrow under a pin you open. Related pins stay folded and don't load until you tap it, and tapping again folds them. Your last choice is kept. Hide related pins wins when both are on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Assistant
patches.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide Inbox updates
patches.description: Leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox, so it doesn't load. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and so do the activity updates in that section. Your messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide blue highlight ring
patches.description: Stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons such as Save to point out a feature. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. Hide comment previews, a separate switch, hides only the previews and comment photos, so the comment box and the way into all comments stay. Another switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. All three start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide creator name on pins
patches.description: Hides the creator's name and badge under a pin you open and keeps their picture, which still opens their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. The Create and Notifications switches also cover those buttons at the top of Home. Home and Profile stay. Two more switches take the row of tabs off the top of Home and make a second press on Search open the keyboard. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pin author
patches.description: Removes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, from under a pin you open. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pin title and description
patches.description: Removes the title and description under a pin you open. The likes and comments bar stays, and so do the posted date and image size when they're on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pop-up banners
patches.description: Closes pop-up banners such as "Shop recommended merchants" the way their X does, so Pinterest records that you dismissed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide related pins
patches.description: Leaves the grid of related pins out from under a pin you open, so it doesn't load. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. A second switch does the same for the messages after a download. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. A second switch leaves only the search bar on the Search page. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories, featured boards and the Shop the look section under a pin. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested boards
patches.description: Hides the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards when you save a pin, such as one it offers to make for you. Your boards and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide survey prompts
patches.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide visual search thumbnails
patches.description: Keeps a pin's lens button plain, without the little stack of cropped pictures Pinterest puts on it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep Home feed
patches.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. A second switch lets Back leave Pinterest from a scrolled-down Home without jumping to the top first. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Let the screen sleep
patches.description: Lets the screen turn off after your phone's usual timeout while a pin is open. Pinterest keeps it on while a video is on the screen, playing or not. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Long-press download
patches.description: Adds a Download button to the menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, the round one and the newer list, so you can save a pin without opening it. Needs Download pins on too. Four more switches take Pinterest's Save, Send, Search image or Send with an app button out of that menu, and another adds View, which shows the pin's picture full screen. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Show image size
patches.description: Shows a picture's width and height under it when you open a pin, beside the posted date when that's on. It reads the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, which can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Show posted date
patches.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original package and signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

It hides only the comments and comment photos shown under a pin, so the comment box and the way into all the comments stay. Hide comments still hides the whole section, previews included, and while it's on the new switch says so and keeps its own setting for later. It starts off.

## Behind the scenes

- Release walks now bind the bundle, stock build and patch selection to the signed APK installed on the test device. Publish rejects missing or mismatched evidence, unsupported app versions, invalid times and reported problems. A survey of an installed app without matching build evidence stays diagnostic only.
- The build runs on Gradle 9.8.2. Gradle 9.7.1 had three high advisories, all fixed in 9.8.1. Two are about the local daemon and workers on the build machine, and the third is a repository fallback that the build's strict dependency checksums already guard against. The build advisory check now reads the Gradle version from the build's dependency report and refuses one in those affected ranges, since the per-library advisory lookup never covers Gradle itself.
- The patched-bytecode check now looks for the hooks where Pinterest 14.44.0 moved them. It still expected Keep Home feed's five-minute check in Home's presenter, the pin menu sheet's Download image row in its onViewCreated and the long-press list in the event handler itself, so every 14.44.0 device build stopped there even though the patches were right.
- The patched-bytecode check now knows Change package name's hook, the one that points Pinterest's own provider names at the installed copy. Every build of a second copy that sits next to Pinterest stopped there with an unclaimed call. The hook itself also checks that Change package name is in the build, like every other hook checks its own patch.
- The whole-app walk now checks that the hooks really ran. Before it restarts Pinterest it turns on every switch it has a screen for. At the end it saves the diagnostics report and fails, naming the family, when Hook status shows a hook that never ran on its screen or missed a target. A paused Hush fails it too, and so does a report that leaves out a family the walk switched on. Families it can't reach count as not exercised rather than passed, and the walk turns its switches back off when it's done. It reaches the Inbox through the button at the top of Home, since Pinterest sends the notifications link to the home feed, and takes an `-Exclude` list for phones without microG-RE.
- The whole-app walk now checks that each screen is the one it meant to open. It works through a numbered case list (Home, a home feed pin's menu and its long-press menu, a pin and its own menu, three searches, the Inbox, the Hush settings and each of their pages) and fails a case when Pinterest's login screen or any other screen shows instead, naming the mark that was missing. The boards and people searches have to show their own filter chip and no pins, so the pins tab can't stand in for them, and the Inbox needs its title with the home feed gone. The long press starts from a fresh look at the home feed with no menu left open and cancels the touch instead of lifting it, so nothing on the menu gets picked. Leaving a case or a hook family out makes the walk PARTIAL. The receipt lists each case with its result and the menu layout Pinterest served, when the walk recognizes it. The walk starts Pinterest first if it isn't running, so the stop always leaves its own record. After that it reads Android's exit records after every screen and fails on any crash, freeze or restart of Pinterest, or a helper process killed while it was still in use. Only the stop's own record and helpers the system cleared once they were idle are excused, and a crash in a cloned or work profile copy of Pinterest doesn't count. Publishing checks all of this again and classes every exit a second time from the facts the receipt keeps, so a receipt from a shorter walk, an older case list, a walk with a failing exit or one without the stop's record can't back a release.
- Release receipts now record how each target's native libraries hold up on phones with Android's 16 KB memory pages. The device build and the receipt build both compare the patched APK's libraries with Pinterest's own, checking their bytes, their compression, the extractNativeLibs flag and `zipalign -c -P 16`. If patching changed, dropped or added a library, or broke alignment Pinterest shipped with, the build stops there. A library Pinterest itself ships off the 16 KB boundary is reported as Pinterest's problem and doesn't stop anything. On 14.44.0 every 64-bit library is aligned and all 68 come through patching unchanged. The receipt marks the check on a real 16 KB device as still to do.
- The build signs the bundle when `HUSHPINTEREST_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` is set and refuses any key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. The release checks the signature again on every copy of the assets, the one it builds, one an earlier run left and one it takes back from GitHub, before anything is uploaded. The index names the key only from a bundle that passed that check.
- The prepare stage checks the source census before it cuts anything. Only publish used to ask, after the GitHub release was already out, so a census older than two weeks stopped a release halfway.
- Changelog entries don't open with a "Pinterest:" label anymore. HushPinterest only patches Pinterest, so it repeated itself on every line. The release scripts stopped adding or asking for it, and drop it from any bullet that still has one when a release is cut.
- The source census now reads a GitLab source's watched folders with one GraphQL question for up to 30 branch and folder pairs, instead of a REST request for each, and asks about each branch comparison only once a run. GitLab lets an address with no token make about 60 REST requests an hour, so a mirror with a few dozen branches ran out before the census could finish. Forks that GitLab has queued for deletion are left out as well. A scanner keeps forking ReVanced's mirror and deleting the fork again, and 92 of the first 100 forks there were waiting to go.
- The source census can now place a bundle in Jman's index that downloads from its project's own server, the way Reseam's do. It takes the GitHub repository the row names only when a release there of the same version carries a file with the hash Jman recorded. Before, every such row came back as an address with no repository, and the census couldn't finish clean. It also asks again when an index answers a server error or a GitHub code search page comes back a hit short, since both clear up within a minute. Only an answer that's still wrong after a few tries holds the census back.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.44.0, version code `14448030`. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer, so there's nothing to merge. Pick that file in Manager.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in. If you'd rather keep the stock app, pick Change package name in Expert mode and HushPinterest installs beside it with its own sign-in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.44.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). The bundle is signed for Morphe Manager with the key in [`morphe-signing.pub`](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub), and Manager should show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

The release commit passed 1198 tests. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.44.0 APK from APKMirror with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 36 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.14.json` records that result, the bundle's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched a Pinterest 14.44.0 that went on an Android emulator for a walk through the whole app. It opened the home feed and its pin menus, a pin, the Inbox, searches for pins, boards and people, and all ten HushPinterest settings pages, 20 screens in all. It turned on 13 switches and checked that each one's hook ran on the screen it changes, and Pinterest didn't crash once. GmsCore support and Spoof signature for Google sign-in were left out of that build, since the emulator has no microG-RE.
